name: dtks-be
description: Production Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 Backend API for DreamTech Kashmir Solutions (DTKS)

scripts.db:migrate:local: cd backend && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply dtks-production-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: cd backend && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply dtks-production-db --remote
scripts.deploy: cd backend && npx wrangler deploy --env production
